slides.title: Two routines
slides.text: Ana is an early bird. She wakes up at six and walks to work at seven. She has lunch at noon and studies English at night. Beto is a night owl. He gets up at eight, works at a cafe in the afternoon and goes to bed at midnight. Their days are different, but both of them are happy.
slides.pt: Ana e Beto têm rotinas diferentes; ela acorda cedo, ele dorme tarde.
